text:
kevin: Starting the midnight cutover. Plan is staggered by region: US -> EU -> APAC. Pinned image: service:v3.12.2. Window: 00:00-02:00 UTC. Canaries + 15m observation between regions. Please post capacity numbers and any red flags.
deploy-bot: Deploy started for US canary slice (slice-id=orbit-1). Jobs: canary-smoke, db-migrate-check, routing-validate. Logs: https://deploy.internal/logs/1767894320
priya: Quick capacity snapshot before handoff:
US (pool-us-prod): free qps 82%, spare GPU nodes 4/24, p95 latency baseline 95ms
EU (pool-eu-prod): free qps 58%, spare GPU nodes 3/18, p95 latency baseline 120ms
APAC (pool-apac-prod): free qps 40%, spare GPU nodes 2/12, p95 latency baseline 140ms
If APAC stays <45% we should avoid moving full traffic.
carla: noted. Keep APAC pinned to v3.11.9 until EU looks healthy. Also watch thermal for apac-gpu-2 (reported higher temp last night).
ops_lead: Rollback / abort criteria we agreed on: error-rate spike >0.7% over 5m, sustained p95 > 600ms for 10m, or any GPU OOMs observed on canary pods. If triggered, immediate rollback and open incident channel #incidents.
kevin: Ack. We'll start US -> monitor 15m -> EU canary -> monitor 15m -> APAC roll only if APAC spare qps >=50%. If EU shows >0.5% errors during canary, pause and revert EU canary only.
deploy-bot: US canary smoke passed (3/3 checks ok). Traffic slice increased to 5%. Metrics: error-rate 0.03%, p95 98ms. Proceeding to EU canary in 2m.
lara: Heads-up to comms: publishing release note blurb. Ben, can you confirm the changelog link & SRE blurb? Need to put in status page if anything unexpected.
ben: Changelog published: https://changelog.internal/3.12.2. SRE blurb ready. Added fallback plan and rollback command snippets. Example rollback command (ops run):
```
# rollback EU canary to pinned v3.11.9
./deployctl rollback --region eu --slice orbit-2 --image service:v3.11.9 --reason "canary regressions"
```
priya: EU canary metrics coming in: error-rate 0.12%, p95 130ms, CPU steady. No OOMs. Spare qps at 62%.
kevin: Good. Proceeding with EU gradual ramp to 15%. APAC still under threshold, keeping pinned. We'll reassess APAC at 01:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: EU canary ramp to 15% done. Smoke-checks green. Notifying rollout dashboard.
carla: re APAC thermal: hand-off ops to night shift to monitor hw temps. If apac-gpu-2 temp > 85C, do not increase traffic and notify infra oncall.
ops_lead: Affirm. Also adding a quick synthetic to measure tail latency in APAC region before any ramp: run synthetic-heavy for 10m post EU ramp.
kevin: Everyone, thanks. Current state: US rolled, EU canary at 15% and healthy, APAC pinned. Next check-in at 01:30 UTC to decide APAC move. If anyone sees anything odd ping me and tag @ops_lead. :thumbsup:
